Dreamed Away

An emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements.

videogame
cozy
horror

Dreamed Away is a videogame by Nicolas Petton, who's also a computer nerd. His website is almost as cool as mine, so you should definitely check him out.

Dreamed Away is a top-down RPG, where all the battles are "duels" between you and an enemy. The combat system (which I had a small part in designing) has your player at the bottom of the screen dodging from left to right... That adds some action to a mostly strategy-focused battle! Some people compare this game to "UNDERTALE," whatever that is.

I've also composed a few tracks available in the game's original soundtrack... That's right: for some reason, Nicolas was interested in my music, even though that's not what anybody knows me for! Well, I did my best, and I think it turned out alright.

Lastly, legends say there is some secret content in the game that I had a great part in developing... see if you can find it and defeat it?

Overall, I recommend you check this game if you like the niche of emotional, cozy horror games.
